recipes.name: Gödel Agent
setup: Prepare requirements.txt and MGSM data; explicitly allow OPENAI_API_KEY in environment_names.

profiles.description: Gödel Agent native MGSM self-referential evolution loop

evaluation.description: Gödel Agent native MGSM self-referential evolution loop Metrics and validity retain the native evaluator contract.

argument_help: No native CLI options; model, goal and MGSM task are fixed by this pinned implementation.
limitations: Source and fixture checks only; dependencies, paid model calls and native end-to-end execution are not verified. Native metrics are not canonical Arena task receipts.
Driver creates a temporary 0600 src/key.env from explicitly inherited OPENAI_API_KEY, never reports/hashes it, and removes it after normal/error/signal exit.
SIGKILL or host failure can prevent secret-file cleanup; use a private disposable workspace.
Self-modifying code executes under the native framework; the profile is MGSM-specific, not every task in the paper.
